text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—And then! Tact climbed up the cliff crazy 
fast! She blew right past me in an 
instant!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you must have had so much fun. To 
overwhelm even you, Epi-san, she really is 
an amazing girl.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Tact has—great talent. A horse girl 
with—high potential...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. Hearing you talk about her 
makes me want to see her.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, there she is. Dance lessons? You're 
working hard.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Cesario-senpai and Kris S-senpai! Are 
you two here for lessons as well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: No. ...How is your—condition?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: ...? Y-Yes. Um, I'm doing great!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, pardon us. We just came to see your 
face today. To check in on how you've been 
lately.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Your dancing has improved so much. I feel 
your expressiveness has become truly rich.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
... ...It's thanks to Epi-senpai. I think 
I've learned how to dance as my heart 
desires.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
However, I still have a long way to go. 
There are still so many things I'm 
lacking.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
I know...! If it's alright with you, would 
you be willing to instruct me? Even just a 
little bit would mean the world to me.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
When I saw you two perform in 『Ligne 
Droite』 before, it was truly magnificent. 
So brilliant, precise... and 
overwhelming...!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to dance like that too. 
Um... not just with feeling, but with 
polished technique as well!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Tact-san, you truly have a drive to 
improve.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Are you—serious about that desire? Our 
instruction is—strict.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I am fully prepared for that! 
You would be dedicating your valuable time 
to me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
............ If you go that far to say it, 
very well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Okay. However—our schedule is tight. We 
will—start a short-term intensive boot 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Core is—essential— Strengthen your—inner 
muscles.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Pitch and rhythm are crucial as well. Let 
the music permeate your entire body.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Understood...! One, two, three...♪ One, 
two, three...♪ Ngh... one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Wrong. Delayed again—from the 
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes...! *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I won't give up...! Because she would 
definitely keep going until she nailed 
it...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
She really does have guts... It makes 
teaching her truly worthwhile.

One day, passing by the dance studio, I 
saw Dearing Tact demonstrating her dance 
for her senpais and receiving their 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Great. You did well—over these 3 days.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Thank you both for your 
valuable guidance!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh, even Trainer-san is here. Fufufu,.

Training under Cesario and Symboli Kris S 
must have been exceptionally harsh. 
Overcoming that, Dearing Tact smiles with 
a glow that is...
choice_data_list:
Looks like there's still room for massive 
growth...!

Looks like there's still plenty of 
potential to unlock...!
You really respect those two, don't you?

text_block_list.text:
Cesario and Symboli Kris S's instruction. 
It must have been extraordinarily strict. 
Overcoming that and smiling like this, 
Dearing Tact is...
choice_data_list:
Looks like you've still got plenty of room 
to grow...!

Looks like you've still got plenty of room 
to grow...!
You really respect those two, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. She is... tough. She has the 
power... to achieve it...!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! I will continue to devote myself so 
that I may live up to those words!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This girl will definitely grow even 
further. I sense a terrifying amount of 
talent in her.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness...! You praise me too much, 
Cesario-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes! They are seniors I truly admire!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That's what she says, Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Ah. I see... um.
